mapper.select: SELECT CAST(dept_id AS CHAR) AS code, dept_name AS name, dept_id AS value FROM sys_dept WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' ORDER BY order_num, dept_id
SELECT post_code AS code, post_name AS name, post_id AS value FROM sys_post WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = '0' ORDER BY post_sort, post_id
SELECT position_code AS code, position_name AS name, id AS value FROM hr_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT dict_value AS code, dict_label AS name, dict_value AS value FROM sys_dict_data WHERE tenant_id IN (0, #{tenantId}) AND dict_type = #{type} AND status = '0' ORDER BY dict_sort, dict_code
SELECT employee_no FROM hr_employee WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_no IN #{code}
